description: Starting a thread through _thread (kept in sys.modules, so the import guard is not involved): the audit hook refuses it on 3.12 and later. 3.11 emits no thread-start audit event, so there RLIMIT_NPROC 0 makes the start fail (RuntimeError), unless the child runs as root.

open_path.note: no thread-start audit event on 3.11 and where RLIMIT_NPROC does not hold (a child running as root, or not Linux) (MSHL-289)
